_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: G. F. Monkshood (b. 1872): Pierre Louÿs's Woman and Puppet (1908) and Bourget's The Story of André Cornélis (1909). US public domain. Added 2026-10-10 by lane C (round 38); Adam may veto. No uids minted.
